For every integer m >= 2, this report constructs one coembedded triangular-lattice packing, its own hexagonal hull, positive contact/facet stress, and its own complete radial response graph. The packing attains its hull's exact Oler capacity and has a trivial fixed-hull feasible velocity cone, but its Schur response has full column rank for an open set of lattice translations. The rank certificate holds for every nonzero edge weighting. A locked three-spoke fan in the same configuration has exactly one crossing response row.

This is an exact regression against deriving positive Schur nullity from locked stress, fixed-container maximality, sparse actual crossings, or affine diameter optimality. It does not refute the canonical Target A endpoint: the family is not a globally optimal triangle-free source. A whole-population disk replacement proves nonglobality for all m >= 32, despite optimality against every feasible affine map.

## Classification and dependencies

- All new infinite-family assertions are proved candidates awaiting one independent owner-operated AI-agent mathematical audit before any promotion. The report and artifact registry remain unreviewed and noncanonical.
- The only imported mathematical inequality is canonical shared Oler Lemma 21.1. Sections 102 and 113 supply response notation; Sections 169, 172, 175, and 177 identify the closing implication being tested.
- No unpromoted PR is a premise. The family coembeds stress and response, whereas Section 149's earlier regression uses independent gadgets. PR #953's source-arm work is distinct.
- Level I, Target A's locked endpoint, and its separate zero-slack endpoint remain open. No state-version increment, route rewrite, or canonical promotion is proposed.

## Proof and reproduction

- Proof: docs/reports/target_a_seed066_coembedded_locked_fullrank_2026-10-13.md
- Exact verifier: python3 -I -O -B research/verify_target_a_seed066_locked_fullrank.py
- Deterministic replay: research/target_a_seed066_locked_fullrank_certificate.json

The verifier checks all 26,103 source pairs and equilibrium at all 334 labels across m = 2, 3, 4, 8; complete response shores; exact Schur elimination; all fan/response crossings; and integer pinned full-rank certificates modulo a verified prime at m = 2, 3, 4. At m = 32 it retains all 3,169 labels, checks all 5,019,696 replacement pairs, and accounts for retained, removed, and created label contacts. Six negative controls fail as required. The all-m and open-phase proofs are analytic; the finite checks do not certify the infinite quantifiers.

## Validation and scope guards

- Theorem-state consistency and PR transaction checks passed locally.
- The 22 theorem-state/tooling tests passed.
- Generated artifact index/header, staged whitespace check, and new relative-link checks passed.
- Guards explicitly distinguish local locking, hull capacity, affine optimality, and global minimum diameter; keep exterior sector overlap; retain every label; avoid identifying independent source matchings; and use no Oler/RSR equality-uniqueness inference.

One independent owner-operated AI-agent mathematical audit is requested, particularly for the open-phase neighbor classification, nonzero-weight Schur determinant, actual-crossing Hall claim, and all-m replacement threshold. No promotion should occur solely on the strength of CI or this author's self-verification.

## Remote CI

GitHub Actions run 38512621143 did not start the state-consistency job. Its check annotation reports the account payment/spending-limit gate. No workflow steps ran. The local checks listed above passed; remote CI is unavailable, rather than a completed mathematical or tooling validation.


**Current mathematical-review policy (2026-10-15):** Consequential canonical promotion requires one project-owner-operated, independent AI-agent audit of the exact commit, covering end-to-end proof reconstruction and adversarial bridge/regression checks. No human mathematical referee or second agent review is required. The result remains noncanonical unless an explicit theorem-state promotion is completed.
